action.description: Required. Selects which Tradebee OpenAPI capability to execute. Route only after the Tradebee data domain and object type are explicit. Page workflow: page-list selects an exact pageName; page-generation-definition returns its authoritative generation contract; links-list supplies real existing website URLs when the generated page needs links; file-upload stores JPG/PNG/GIF images needed by page HTML or CSS; page-html reads or previews without saving; page-save creates or updates only after final preview and explicit confirmation. Existing page overwrites are backed up locally. Other domains use their matching read, create, update, or delete actions. For rule-based HTML fragments, rule-get provides scene constraints; when links are needed, links-list provides real URLs under the same language instead of legacy link_resources. Every URL used from links-list must be a relative path without a protocol, hostname, domain, or //host prefix. Never prepend data.host or the website domain.

uploads.description: Required by file-upload. JPG, PNG, or GIF images; each decoded image must be 500 kB or smaller. Match results by name. Every data.success[] item returns name, url, and fileState. fileState contains the exact fields Suffix, Type, Guid, Width, Height, and ContentLength; preserve that casing and pass the object through unchanged when a downstream schema requires file metadata.

pageName.description: Required by page-generation-definition, page-html, and page-save. Use one exact pageName returned by page-list.

layouts.description: Optional for page-html and required for page-save. Must satisfy the current outputSchema returned by page-generation-definition for the same pageName.

css.description: Optional for page-html and page-save. Keys are 0 or numeric module IDs and values are CSS strings. Upload new images with file-upload and use returned URLs before preview or save.

type.description: Optional link category used by links-list; defaults to main. Use an exact value returned by links-list data.group. Every selected data.list[].url must be a relative path without a protocol, hostname, domain, or //host prefix. Never prepend data.host or the website domain. If a returned URL contains a domain, do not use or rewrite it; report the invalid result.

content.description: Optional first-level custom child-navigation HTML fragment. Before generating this field, call rule-get with the exact selected language and exact scene=navigation.content; stop if the call fails. For update, call rule-get only when replacing this field. Follow the returned payload: use one root section with a unique scoped class and one embedded style block at the end. Inline style attributes and external stylesheet links are forbidden. Do not include H1; prefer H2-H6. Each img src must be an HTTP(S) URL returned by file-upload; embedded base64 data URLs are not supported by the Tradebee plugin. Upload each image first and use its data.success[].url. At most 50 images are allowed. The 100,000-character limit is calculated after removing img tags. Use non-empty content only with system_children_type=0 and no manual children. It must be empty for system children, manual-child mode, and every second-level item. On update, an empty string or omitted field leaves the current content unchanged. After rule-get succeeds, if this fragment needs existing website links, call the unified tradebee action links-list with the same exact language. Start with type=main or a category already returned by data.group[].options[].value; follow data.pagination.has_next_page and next_page until the destination is found or results end. Copy data.list[].url exactly. Legacy rule-get link_resources is not the URL source for this workflow. If no links are needed, skip links-list. If lookup fails or no matching destination exists, report it and do not invent a URL.

backup.description: Returned by update actions and by page-save when an existing member page is overwritten. It includes local backup storage metadata, the pre-change API response and snapshot, a restore payload, and any restore limitations.
